newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning on Dow, futures.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning on Dow, futures.

text.p: Tokyo stocks leapt in early Tuesday morning trade, supported by the Dow industrials' rally to another record in New York and a surge in the Nikkei average's futures overnight.
But rises in the key Nikkei average may be capped at 21,500, brokers said.
At 0013 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 86.45 points or 0.41 percent at 21,380.02. Its December futures were 120 points higher at 21,420.
"Domestic investors are interested in selling when the Nikkei average nears 21,500," said an analyst at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
